name: SCP Foundation
description: A collaborative online horror-fiction project, begun on 4chan's /x/ board in 2007 and given its own wiki in 2008, in which thousands of authors document a fictional 'Foundation' that secures, contains, and protects anomalous objects and entities. All content is published under CC BY-SA.

aliases.name: Special Containment Procedures Foundation
aliases.meaning: in-fiction expansion of the acronym; sometimes glossed as 'Secure, Contain, Protect'

aliases.name: SCP Wiki
aliases.meaning: primary host site of the collaborative fiction

regions: Major translation branches across East Asia, Europe and the Americas
origin: Global internet phenomenon. The English SCP Wiki is the primary site; substantial translation branches exist in Russian, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), French, German, Polish, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Thai, Czech, Vietnamese, Ukrainian and other languages.
